items.name: Codex
items.description: A rare, valuable Codex. Looks like it may have some currently unknown utility. Think carefully before getting rid of. Codexes are the highest value loot a scav can find. They are extremely rare due to the difficulty in acquiring them from enemies that are extremely difficult or outright impossible to down by normal means. The following bosses each have their own named codex: Rat King Europan Medium Mech (Euruskan Medium Mech shares the same Codex) Grabber* (Stalker shares the same Codex) Toothy Euruskan OrgaMech Euruskan Shield Officer Euruskan Kotleta** Eurasian MotherCourage Eurasian Opal While the Grabber is confirmed to be lootable, it may take several raids, as it sometimes refuses to get stunned after 5+ railgun hits. Its container also spawns far from its body, making it likely to end up out of map bounds. Unlike other Codexes, Kotleta's Codex can spawn on the ground at raid start and triggers unique events when picked up. See Kotleta for more info.

items.description: Kenetic (HRF), Uses .50 Cal. Can One Shot Headshot most Foot Soldiers, including Hunter Killers. Can also be used against Exo Skeletons and Tanks, but need a lot of Sucessfull Hits. Pros and Cons compared to other Bolt Action HRF: + Can Equip Any Regular Scope + Highest Base Accuracy, can be improved with mods to be over 89, making it possible to land guaranteed headshots at LvL 1 Weapon experience - Difficult to get, only possible from Quest Rewards

items.name: Destroyed Grenade Launcher
items.description: Grenade Launcher. Uses 40mm HE A semi-automatic Grenade Launcher with a magazine capacity of 6 rounds. Uses 40mm HE. It has nearly unrivaled damage; it is capable of defeating the majority of infantry units, including Europan Hunter Killers in a single direct hit. The Grenade Launcher's damage is partially misleading. The Grenade Launcher deals 1,000 damage on direct impact with its 40mm projectile, however deals an additional 10,000 splash damage. This (presumably) allows the Grenade Launcher to deal up to 11,000 Damage assuming optimal conditions.
